title: Correcting WHERE, Preserving HOW: Compositional Generalization for Vision-Language-Action Models via Referential Guidance
abstract: arXiv:2609.38616v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: While Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models enable flexible action generation, their generalization across diverse environmental elements, including manipulated objects, destinations, and backgrounds, is limited by the lack of diversity in robotic training data. Trained end-to-end on such data, VLAs tend to exploit visual shortcuts, associating actions with task-irrelevant visual features rather than the intended task semantics. These shortcuts block recomposition of elements already seen by the policy, that is, compositional generalization. Existing approaches mitigate such entanglement through task-relevant perception or targeted data diversification, but offer no explicit mechanism for unseen recomposition and require backbone-specific modifications with retraining. We observe that under such recomposition, VLAs often fail at global grounding while retaining local manipulation skills that recover near the correct target in familiar co

translated_title: 纠正“去哪里”，保留“怎么做”：通过指代引导实现视觉-语言-动作模型的组合泛化
translated_abstract: 尽管视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型能够实现灵活的动作生成，但其在多种环境要素（包括被操作物体、目的地和背景）上的泛化能力受限于机器人训练数据多样性的不足。由于在这些数据上进行端到端训练，VLA模型倾向于利用视觉捷径，将动作与任务无关的视觉特征相关联，而非预期的任务语义。这些捷径阻碍了策略对已见元素的重新组合，即组合泛化。现有方法通过任务相关感知或针对性的数据多样化来缓解这种纠缠问题，但缺乏针对未见重新组合的显式机制，且需要对骨干网络进行特定修改并重新训练。我们观察到，在这种重新组合的情况下，VLA模型往往在全局定位上失败，同时仍保留了在熟悉场景中能接近正确目标的局部操作技能……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文提出“指代引导”方法，通过纠正VLA模型在重新组合场景下的全局定位失败（WHERE），同时保留其已有的局部操作技能（HOW），无需修改骨干网络或重新训练即可实现组合泛化。
en_tdlr: Proposes a Referential Guidance approach that corrects global grounding failures (WHERE) of VLA models under recomposed scenes while preserving their local manipulation skills (HOW), enabling compositional generalization without backbone-specific modifications or retraining.
